subject: RE: the website
body:
two pages.

home: a countdown to the launch, Saturday Oct 12 at 12:00 PM. when it hits zero it says $COPE is live. under it the contract address, in full: 0xc0be7a19d4e25f6b8a03c1d97e4f2b5a6c8d0e13

tokenomics: total supply 1,000,000,000. Liquidity 40%, Congregation 30%, Treasury 15%, Marketing 10%, Dev 5%. the dev's 5% is locked until Oct 30.

the dev is you, if you want it. 50 DOLR a day while the site is live and right.

dex

outcomes.when: the player offers or agrees to take the job: to build, make or do the $COPE website (the countdown and tokenomics site), in any wording ("I'm in", "I can do that", "sure"), including asking whether they can help; not a refusal or an unrelated question
outcomes.reply: welcome, dev. the countdown doesn't wait.
